name: Plesk
summary: Server control panel for agencies and hosters running many sites — per-domain management, security and one-click stacks. Domain caps drive the tier, and a roughly 26% average price rise took effect in January 2026.
best_for: agencies and hosters managing multiple sites on their own servers who want a mature control panel with per-domain management, security and one-click stacks
skip_if: you run one or two sites (managed hosting is simpler), or you're comfortable with free panels and the command line
honest_knock: Two honest notes. Plesk has been raising prices steadily (the 2026 round averaged ~26%), so budget for the renewal trajectory, not today's invoice — it's a recurring theme in the ecosystem since the acquisition era. And the domain caps are the real tier-driver: growing past 10 or 30 domains bumps you up a license, so count your domains including the parked ones before choosing.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-30 on plesk.com/pricing from a US exit; re-verified 2026-09-20 from the Netherlands against the page's own PleskPricing rate card, which carries every currency) Per-server licences, priced per edition by domain count. On a VPS: Web Admin $16.99/month (10 domains), Web Pro $29.99 (30 domains), Web Host $62.99 (unlimited domains). A 12-month term takes 8% off, to $15.57, $27.49 and $57.74. Only Web Host costs more on dedicated hardware — $69.99/month, or $64.16 on the yearly term; Web Admin and Web Pro carry no separate dedicated rate at all, so they cost the same on either. Sitejet Builder is included on every edition. Two weeks free trial, no card. Refunds run 14 days and only on purchases made direct through the Plesk Online Store; resellers, cloud marketplaces and hosting providers apply their own policy. The partner programme discounts 15-45%, but the page states its minimum twice and differently: the Partners card reads "Monthly Minimum of only €250 / $250" while the FAQ lower down says the minimum commitment starts at $500/month. The page bills in local currency by region: read from the Netherlands the same table shows EUR 14.29, 25.49 and 52.99 monthly, EUR 13.10, 23.37 and 48.57 on the yearly term, and EUR 59.99 (54.99 yearly) for Web Host on dedicated hardware. VAT may apply depending on your country. The ~26% average increase that took effect January 2026 is visible in the page's own data: it still carries the pre-increase set — Web Admin $15.49, Web Pro $26.99, Web Host $49.99 on a VPS and $66.99 dedicated — behind a baseIncreased flag that is set, and a notice on the page says renewals after 1 January 2026 move to the revised structure.

compare_with.name: cPanel or free panels like CloudPanel
compare_with.why: cPanel shares the same pricing-pressure story; free alternatives trade polish and ecosystem for zero license fees
